import "strings"

from(bucket: "venus")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_measurement"] == "system/Ac/ActiveIn/GridParallel" or
      r["_measurement"] == "settings/Settings/Services/Bluetooth" or
      r["_measurement"] == "settings/Settings/Services/AccessPoint" or
      r["_measurement"] == "settings/Settings/Services/EthernetLinkLocal" or
      r["_measurement"] == "settings/Settings/Services/Evcc" or
      r["_measurement"] == "settings/Settings/Services/Modbus" or
      r["_measurement"] == "settings/Settings/Services/MqttLocal" or
      r["_measurement"] == "settings/Settings/System/ActiveNetworkConnection"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _measurement: strings.trimPrefix(
          v: r._measurement,
          prefix: "settings/Settings/"
      )
  }))
  |> drop(columns: ["_field", "name", "portalId"])

  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_field", "instanceNumber", "name", "portalId"])

pv =
  from(bucket: "venus")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_measurement"] == "pvinverter/Ac/Power"
    )
    |> last()
    |> group()
    |> sum()
    |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "pv")

grid =
  from(bucket: "venus")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_measurement"] == "grid/Ac/Power" or
      r["_measurement"] == "battery/Dc/0/Power" or
      r["_measurement"] == "battery/Soc"
    )
    |> last()
    |> keep(columns: ["_value", "_measurement"])

load =
  from(bucket: "venus")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r["_measurement"] == "system/Ac/ConsumptionOnOutput/L3/Power" or
      r["_measurement"] == "system/Ac/ConsumptionOnOutput/L2/Power" or
      r["_measurement"] == "system/Ac/ConsumptionOnOutput/L1/Power"
    )
    |> last()
    |> group()
    |> sum()
    |> set(key: "_measurement", value: "load")

union(tables: [pv, grid, load])
  |> pivot(
      rowKey: [],
      columnKey: ["_measurement"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
    )
